column1: # Final QM9 property-steering configs behind the multiMFM / multiMFM-SS rows of Table 2.
# One line per property. Reproduce with:   scripts/reproduce_steer_table.sh
# Then emit the LaTeX rows with:           python3 scripts/steer_table.py
# Selection criterion used to pick each row: lowest held-out-oracle MAE over
# PoseBusters-valid molecules, subject to final-endpoint PB validity in
# [0.90, 0.93], AND steer-search beating the final endpoint on both MAE and PB.
# All rows use the CE/ESD student sampled with flow-map jumps -- the configuration the
# paper ships. (A per-property best-of {ce+jump, repo+diag} was also measured; the
# shipped single configuration is within noise of it on every property except cv.)
# CKPT: ce  = checkpoints/mfm_student_ce_esd/student_step_100000.pt  (diagonal-CE + ESD
#             student, same size as the teacher: hidden 64 / 4 layers / 4 heads, 363k params,
#             trained with --time-encoding-max-len 4; sampled with 4 flow-map jumps)
#       repo = checkpoints/mfm_student/student_step_1000.pt  (shipped diagonal-only student;
#             sampled with 4 diagonal Euler steps, the mode it was trained for)
# MODE: jump = off-diagonal flow-map jumps v(s,u);  diag = instantaneous v(s,s) Euler steps
# MU:   guidance step size            RS:   reward_scale
# CRMS/ARMS: per-molecule RMS cap on the coordinate / atom guidance gradient (0 = off)
# SMT:  --select-min-t, the earliest t whose look-ahead steer-search may select. This is the
#       parameter that makes steer-search competitive with the final endpoint; at 0.3 it was not.
# STEPS: outer ODE steps   VS: inner trajectories per look-ahead   VSTEPS: inner steps each
# prop   ckpt  mode  mu     rs      crms  arms  smt   steps  vs   vsteps  n
